title: What If the Brooke Family Still Governed Sarawak?
notes: Single source of truth for timing. 'at' = earliest start (seconds, absolute). The audio builder pushes a line later if the previous line is still speaking. TTS text may contain [word](/ipa/) overrides for Malay words.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What if the Brooke family STILL ruled Sarawak?
lines.tts: What if the Brooke family still ruled [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/)?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yep. Still jam.
lines.tts: Yep. Still jam.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In 1841, James Brooke became Rajah of Sarawak.
lines.tts: In eighteen forty-one, James Brooke became Rajah of [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three Brooke Rajahs ruled. Then, in 1946, Sarawak became a British Crown Colony.
lines.tts: Three Brooke Rajahs ruled. Then in nineteen forty-six, [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/) became a British Crown Colony.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But what if that never happened?
lines.tts: But what if... that never happened?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The real 1946 cession vote passed: nineteen to sixteen.
lines.tts: The real cession vote passed. Nineteen to sixteen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In our made-up timeline... it fails.
lines.tts: In our made-up timeline... it fails.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fast-forward to 2026.
lines.tts: Fast forward, to twenty twenty-six!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Welcome to the Kingdom of Sarawak!
lines.tts: Welcome, to the Kingdom of [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/)!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Flying cars. Golden palaces. Royal everything.
lines.tts: Flying cars. Golden palaces. Royal... everything.

lines.speaker: driver
lines.text: Your Majesty... jalan sik bagus.
lines.tts: Your Majesty... [jalan sik bagus](/dʒˈɑːlɐn sˈɪk bˈɑːɡʊs/).

lines.speaker: rajah
lines.text: Again?!
lines.tts: Again?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even royalty cannot escape road maintenance.
lines.tts: Even royalty cannot escape... road maintenance.

lines.speaker: minister
lines.text: Your Majesty, your elected government presents: the 2026 Development Plan!
lines.tts: Your Majesty, your elected government presents... the twenty twenty-six Development Plan!

lines.speaker: auntie
lines.text: Royal or not, fix the road lah!
lines.tts: Royal or not, fix the road lah!

lines.speaker: rajah
lines.text: Y-yes, Auntie. Right away, Auntie.
lines.tts: Y... yes, Auntie. Right away, Auntie.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Maybe Sarawak becomes a global technology and energy powerhouse!
lines.tts: Maybe [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/) becomes a global technology and energy powerhouse!

lines.speaker: minister
lines.text: Introducing the Royal Hyperloop: Kuching to Miri in twenty minutes!
lines.tts: Introducing, the Royal Hyperloop! Kuching to [Miri](/mˈiːɹi/) in twenty minutes!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some traditions never change.
lines.tts: Some traditions... never change.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But would Sarawak really be richer, more powerful... and happier?
lines.tts: But would [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/) really be richer, more powerful... and happier?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Or would we have the same problems... with more expensive ceremonies?
lines.tts: Or would we have the same problems... with more expensive ceremonies?

lines.speaker: rajah
lines.text: Ahh... my beautiful kingdom.
lines.tts: Ahh... my beautiful kingdom.

lines.speaker: rajah
lines.text: Aduh! Laundry belum angkat!
lines.tts: [Aduh](/ɐdˈuː/)! Laundry, [belum angkat](/bəlˈʊm ˈɑŋkɑt/)!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Team Rajah, or Team Reality? Comment below.
lines.tts: Team Rajah... or Team Reality? Comment below!
